title: 3D product hero
description: Your own 3D model (.glb) on the slide, lit like a product shot by the connect-ai-three stage (lessons 6-7): the camera pushes in and slowly circles while the object turns, the title rises letter by letter beside it. Keeps moving while the slide is on screen.

props.title: heading, 1-6 words
props.sub: one short line under the title
props.items: up to 4 short lines (a list beside the object)
props.spin: turn speed in degrees per second (default 7)

example.title: A real 3D object
example.sub: Any .glb from your folder, lit and turning
